//: Compose-only overlay of config/oam-gui-bff.json (ADR-0442), selected by the OAM-GUI-BFF_CONFIG_FILE env var (nf_config::load's <SERVICE>_CONFIG_FILE convention, uppercased with hyphens intact). Deliberately NOT under config/: gui/schema-gen/derive_nf_config_schemas.py globs every config/*.json as one NF-config component, and ADR-0391 forbids a duplicate SBI port (8710) across two config/*.json files -- this file is a second, deployment-specific view of the SAME component, not a second component, so it lives beside the other deploy/docker/*.Dockerfile artifacts instead.
//paths: Every path below is ABSOLUTE (/build/...), not relative, even though config/oam-gui-bff.json's own defaults are relative. Relative paths in that file resolve against REPO_ROOT, a COMPILE-TIME constant (gui/bff/CMakeLists.txt: target_compile_definitions(oam-gui-bff PRIVATE REPO_ROOT="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}")) -- for oam-gui-bff.Dockerfile's builder stage CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR is /build, so relative paths would have worked there too, but making them absolute here removes the dependency on that compile-time value entirely and is what let this config also drive a binary built directly on the host during verification (whose baked REPO_ROOT was the build host's own path, not /build) against the exact same /build/... runtime layout every oam-gui-bff image (official or hand-packaged) already uses. main.cpp's own resolve() leaves an absolute path untouched, so this is a pure config value change, not a behaviour change.
//oidc: config/oam-gui-bff.json's oidc block has no per-field env-var override (main.cpp reads it with oidc_cfg.at(...) directly, not nf_config::require), and the split ADR-0441 anticipated -- token_endpoint/jwks_uri at Keycloak's in-network name, issuer/authorization_endpoint/end_session_endpoint/redirect_uri at the externally-visible one the browser and operator_iam's (idp_issuer, sub) rows use -- needs whole-object replacement, hence this whole-file overlay rather than a handful of OAM_GUI_BFF_* env vars.
